title: Microscopy and Ultrastructure
description: The organization of cells, tissues and organs are presented through lectures and in the laboratory, through the microscopic study of histological sections and illustrations.
prerequisites: Some background in Biology, including one or more such courses as Biology, Zoology, Botany, Histo- logical techniques, Comparative Anatomy or Embryology, and enrollment in the College of Medicine or a graduate program in the bio-medical sciences. In addition, students from graduate programs outside of anatomy must obtain the consent of the course director before registration
